name: com.tencent.qcloud.tim.push.permission.PermissionActivity
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s push SDK opens this screen when the app requests a runtime permission or notification-listener access; it explains the request, opens Android's permission or settings screen, and returns the result.
disableEffect: If the app starts this permission flow while the screen is disabled, the screen cannot open and notification access or the requested permission setup fails.
